summary: Phase S3 fails final public API and developer-experience review. The focused tests and affected package builds are green and all new exported declarations have JSDoc, but the only public mastery subpath eagerly initializes the database, the exported Drizzle adapter cannot satisfy the exported orchestration dependency, public commit schemas/types describe incompatible commands, unexpected database failures are mislabeled as validation errors, two frozen uniqueness contracts were removed, and migration 0027 has no committed Drizzle snapshot.
blocking_findings: S3-API-001 [High] packages/domain/src/mastery/index.ts:1-7 and packages/domain/src/mastery/record-run.ts:1-13 — importing @reading-advantage/domain/mastery for Zod contracts or the in-memory adapter statically evaluates legacy record-run.ts and @reading-advantage/db. A real built-package cold import emits 'DATABASE_URL is not set' and takes 1.18s even though the Drizzle factory itself is lazy. This violates the provider-neutral package boundary and gives Advantage-app consumers no DB-free public persistence entrypoint. Add a provider-neutral persistence subpath/barrel or lazily isolate the legacy DB-bound record-run surface, then add a cold-import test asserting no DB initialization or warning.

S3-API-002 [High] packages/domain/src/mastery/index.ts:23-78, packages/domain/src/mastery/persistence-ports.ts:33-50, and packages/domain/src/mastery/commit-evidence.ts:142-177 — the public surface exposes two incompatible commit models under overlapping names. createDrizzleMasteryPersistence returns MasteryPersistencePort, while commitMasteryEvidence requires MasteryTransactionalPersistence; a consumer compile probe fails TS2741 because the adapter has no transaction method. The public commitMasteryEvidenceInputSchema is additionally a union that accepts the adapter command even though commitMasteryEvidence reparses only the orchestration command, and CommitMasteryEvidenceInput names only the adapter type. Define one composable application path: either make the Drizzle adapter implement/export the transactional port or provide a public transactional adapter, and keep each runtime schema aligned one-to-one with its function and inferred type.

S3-API-003 [High] packages/domain/src/mastery/drizzle-mastery-persistence.ts:223-240 — portableFailure maps every unexpected driver, connectivity, missing-migration, timeout, and programmer failure to MasteryPersistenceError code VALIDATION_ERROR. Applications cannot distinguish caller-invalid data from retryable infrastructure failures, and the original cause is discarded. Add a provider-neutral infrastructure/internal error code with retryability and safe cause handling; reserve VALIDATION_ERROR for Zod/boundary failures and test a simulated non-23505 database outage.

S3-API-004 [High] packages/db/src/schema/mastery.ts:234-321 and packages/db/src/__tests__/mastery-persistence-schema.test.ts:103-131 — the Green commit removed the Red contract expectations for mastery_placements_school_student_objective_release_type_unique and mastery_calibrations_school_population_version_unique, then implemented neither constraint. This contradicts phase-s3-test-strategy.md and permits duplicate logical placement/calibration artifacts behind the public adapter. Restore both tenant-aware unique constraints in schema, migration, and tests rather than weakening the frozen Red oracle.

S3-API-005 [High] packages/db/drizzle/meta/_journal.json:194-200 — the committed journal consumes 0027_mastery_persistence, but commit 08e942a2 contains no packages/db/drizzle/meta/0027_snapshot.json. The schema test named 'does not accept a hand-written migration without the generated schema snapshot' only checks that schema/mastery.ts exists, so it cannot detect this omission. Commit the generated 0027 snapshot and make the guard assert the matching snapshot/journal pair so future drizzle-kit generation starts from the actual schema state.
nonblocking_findings: S3-API-006 [Medium] packages/domain/src/mastery/drizzle-mastery-persistence.ts:40-46 and 243-249 — DrizzleMasteryPersistenceOptions types both db and tenantDb as unknown, casts db internally, and explicitly ignores tenantDb. This accepts nonsensical construction at compile time and advertises tenant composition that does nothing. Type db to the supported schema-aware Drizzle contract and remove or implement tenantDb.

S3-API-007 [Medium] packages/domain/package.json and packages/domain/src/mastery/index.ts — the package exports 28 mastery symbols and two distinct commit pathways but adds no README, usage example, error-code table, transaction composition example, or migration guidance for Advantage-app consumers. Add concise consumer documentation after the public contract is consolidated.

S3-API-008 [Medium] graph.db — the fresh graph contains commit-evidence.ts and drizzle-mastery-persistence.ts but omits the new persistence-contracts.ts, persistence-ports.ts, in-memory adapter, and mastery DB schema. Graph caller results therefore show no external callers for indexed additive symbols but are incomplete; rerun per-file graph updates and audit before claiming graph verification.

S3-API-009 [Low] packages/domain/src/index.ts:41-46 — commit 08e942a2 also adds unrelated reading FSRS scheduler exports outside the Phase S3 file ownership and public API scope. Preserve them only with their owning-track evidence or separate them from the mastery persistence commit.
evidence: Exact implementation scope: 08e942a2 adds 16 S3 files/changes with 2307 insertions and six deletions; f005e0fc records the Green gate and plan evidence.

Public export inspection confirms @reading-advantage/domain/mastery exposes all requested Zod records, inferred types, in-memory factory, lazy Drizzle factory, orchestration functions, and errors; @reading-advantage/db exports all seven tables.
Built-package self-import succeeds with 28 mastery exports, but emits the DATABASE_URL warning before any adapter operation; root and namespace exports are both reachable.
Consumer-shaped TypeScript probe assigning createDrizzleMasteryPersistence({ db }) to MasteryTransactionalPersistence fails with TS2741: transaction is missing from MasteryPersistencePort.
TypeScript AST JSDoc audit inspected every exported function, class, interface, type alias, schema, and table declaration added by S3 and found zero undocumented exports.

The four focused persistence suites pass 4 files and 58/58 tests with one worker, but the schema test passes only because the Green commit changed the two frozen uniqueNames expectations to empty arrays and the migration-snapshot test does not inspect meta snapshots.

Domain check-types passes. DB check-types is inconclusive for S3 because unrelated untracked packages/db/src/seed/codecamp-users-seed.ts imports auth source outside db rootDir and triggers TS6059 errors.
DB and domain builds pass. DB lint passes with nine unrelated/inherited warnings; domain lint passes with 21 unrelated/inherited warnings and no S3-file warning.
No frontend files are in the S3 implementation commits, so browser, visual, network, and route-parity review are not applicable.

Graph caller check finds no external callers for the indexed new additive public symbols; no non-additive caller break was detected, but the graph is missing four S3 files and is not sufficient as complete acceptance evidence.

test_strategy_violations: The Green implementation changed the committed Red schema contract to remove the placement and calibration unique constraints instead of satisfying it.
The migration-snapshot guard claims to require a generated snapshot but checks only for schema/mastery.ts, allowing journal entry 0027 without 0027_snapshot.json.
The graph verification claim is incomplete because four new S3 files are absent from graph.db.
live_contract_violations: The public mastery contract-only import eagerly initializes the DB-bound legacy record-run module and emits a DATABASE_URL warning.
The public commit schema accepts both adapter and orchestration commands while the public commitMasteryEvidence function accepts only the orchestration command.
prod_wiring_violations: The exported Drizzle adapter does not implement the exported MasteryTransactionalPersistence interface required by commitMasteryEvidence, so the production adapter cannot be injected into the production orchestration function.
